authoring: Separate evaluation agent using agreed grammar and manually specified gold; no forthcoming parser or kernel code read before freeze.
scope: Controlled Arabic only; the source materials are authored for this evaluation, not quotations from books or a natural-language corpus.
grammar: Concept/relation/entity declarations; exact unary and binary signed facts; explicit biconditional definitions; safe signed Horn rules with conjunction; universal unary implication; ground signed questions; guillemet-quoted exact labels; ?-prefixed rule variables.
semantics: Signed closure first. Both signs conflict. Clean closure excludes globally conflicted heads/premises. Clean query proof supports/refutes; only tainted proof defers with CONTESTED_PREMISES; absent proof is unknown. No CWA, contraposition, existence from definitions, symmetry, or world-truth inference.
builder_exposure: Builders see grammar and API contract only; no case text or gold before first complete frozen run.
partition_policy: First40 is opened first. Reserve20 remains sealed until a separate implementation snapshot is frozen. A fix after seeing first40 feedback is a disclosed adaptation; no first40 rerun is described as heldout.

episodes.note: Conjoined members imply a previously unknown defined predicate.
